# check validates unexpected task entries, duplicate IDs, and stale projections.
exec tuck$exe init
mkdir tasks/unexpected
cp first-task.md tasks/todo/001-first.md
cp duplicate-task.md tasks/todo/002-second.md
cp order-gap-task.md tasks/todo/003-third.md

exitcode 1 check --json
json
stdout '"ok": false'
stdout '"task_count": 3'
stdout 'unexpected entry in tasks directory'
stdout 'duplicate task id'
stdout 'duplicate task number'
stdout 'filename number must match front matter number 001'
stdout 'todo order must be contiguous starting at 1'
stdout 'projection is stale; run tuck sync'
stderr 'found 6 board issue'

cp board.md projection-before-sync.md
exitcode 1 sync --json
json
stdout '"synced": false'
stderr 'warning: tasks/unexpected'
stderr 'duplicate task id'
cmp board.md projection-before-sync.md

---
# First valid task
